product.name: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 4.2 GHz 8-Core Processor
product.description: The AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D is a high-performance desktop processor featuring 8 cores and 16 threads, based on the Zen 4 microarchitecture with Raphael core family. It operates at a base clock of 4.2 GHz and can boost up to 5 GHz. It includes 8 MB of L2 cache and a large 96 MB L3 cache, supports up to 128 GB of memory with ECC support, and uses the AM5 socket. The processor has a TDP of 120 W, includes integrated Radeon graphics, and does not come with a CPU cooler. It is packaged boxed and manufactured using a 5 nm lithography process. It supports simultaneous multithreading for improved multitasking performance.
